questions: How many devices did you fabricate and measure, and how many showed the 0.5 e²/h plateaus? Fig. 2b calls devices I, II and III "representative".
Why were the others set aside?
Which field ranges, field directions and temperatures did you measure beyond the ones shown, in particular the negative-field side for Fig. 2b and fields above the Nb critical field?
What do devices II and III look like at 20 mK, over full sweeps in both directions?
What is the resistance of the Nb-film interface, and could you measure it through the Nb bar's own leads (Isc, Vsc in Fig. 1b)?
How many reversal sweeps did you take at a fixed temperature, at what sweep rate, and do the plateau fields and values repeat from sweep to sweep?

How is σ12 computed from V12 and I12, how were the plateau values and uncertainties (for example 0.49 and ±0.05 e²/h) read off, and why does σ12 at the highest fields in Fig. 2b sit near 0.7 e²/h at 350 mK?
Fig. 3c shows the control Hall bar from 350 mK up; what does its σ12 look like at 20 mK, next to Fig. 2c?
